jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Networking DGX Cloud
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is looking for an experienced software engineer with infrastructure experience to become a senior member of the Cloud Foundations Automation - Development Team. We build and manage the automation ecosystem supporting NVIDIA's GPU Cloud and NVIDIA SuperPod deployments. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most hard-working and dedicated people on the planet working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

What You'll Be Doing

Developing software to enable efficient network design, deployment and day 2 management.
Building product focused software solutions, used by internal and external customers.
Helping us as we transform our workflows and organization into a centrally orchestrated configuration management framework, operating at scale across geographies.
Owning and driving integrations with various service APIs such as Cloud Service Providers, to automate creation of environments and auto populate data sources in turn.
Building on open source software, designing and implementing data structures and UI interfaces to automate processes from equipment purchase to device config generation to deployment to operations.
Streamlining deployment mechanisms and life cycle operations Developing modern service architectures around streaming data and event pipelines.
Working with infrastructure domain experts on true, zero touch deployment solutions and utilizing best of breed high performance computing management solutions.
Be a proactive problem solver, looking out for new opportunities to improve our services and customer experience. Communicate readily with your peers across the organization, building relationships and collaborating enthusiastically.

What We Need To See

BS or equivalent experience with 12+ yrs of relevant industry experience.
Background in networking and network automation (Datacenter / PoPs / Routing)
Strong proficiency in Python and Go web frameworks.
Experience building and shipping production quality software products.
Experience with DCIM tools like Netbox or Nautobot and expertise in designing and implementing network configuration management systems.
Familiarity with containerization using Kubernetes (on-premises, EKS) and streaming telemetry protocols like gRPC/GNMI.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

You have architected, built, and deployed a network for a large scale (1000s of machines) in the past, used by 100s of engineers
Hands-on experience with building tooling and automation for provisioning, monitoring, and managing the network infrastructure.
Understanding of networking technologies such as VRFs, VxLAN, EVPN, BGP/OSPF/ISIS and datacenter design.

NVIDIA’s invention of the GPU in 1999 fueled the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern deep learning — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Today, we are increasingly known as “the AI computing company.” We're looking to grow our company and establish teams with the most thoughtful people in the world. Are you ready to change the next generation of computing? Join us at the forefront of technological advancement.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 200,000 USD - 322,000 USD for Level 5, and 248,000 USD - 391,000 USD for Level 6.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 6, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Senior, Software Engineer
jobs.description:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

What We Believe In

We build software for the world's most ambitious brands, and we're opinionated about how it gets made:

Code quality is a top priority. Style guides, code reviews, and best practices are how we move fast without breaking things. You'll also get your hands on a wide range of cutting-edge technology.
Great UI/UX is critical. Aesthetics, usability, and speed are all part of the product. A technically correct experience that feels bad isn't finished.
Collaboration wins projects. Great communication is the single strongest predictor of whether a project goes well.
We're pragmatic. We know what to build and what to leave alone, and we make real-world tradeoffs between cost, speed, and craft. Shipping something useful beats architecting something perfect.
We're intellectually curious. We're constantly learning through craft show & tells, lunch & learns, workshares, and active Slack channels full of talented engineers across the globe.

The role

As a Senior Engineer, you own significant portions of a project and drive them to completion. You take a semi-defined problem, ask the questions that sharpen it, turn it into a plan, and ship it. You're past the stage of needing fully specified tasks handed to you, and you're building the judgment to know which task matters most.

You're comfortable working alongside product managers, engineers, marketing, sales, and finance, and you can explain your work to any of them without retreating into jargon. Most of what we build depends on getting those people to a shared understanding of what's being made and why.

This role is primarily backend focused, occasionally diving into cloud infrastructure. However, you should also be comfortable enough in a modern frontend codebase to apply best practices and create something visually appealing and smooth to use.

What You'll Do

Build and deploy scalable backend services and APIs for global brands, taking high ownership of your workstreams and their dependencies.
Take specs that are incomplete or ambiguous, resolve the open questions, and turn them into clear requirements, tasks, and stories with time-to-complete estimates people can plan around.
Participate in technical design of systems, schemas, and pipelines, and offer sound guidance on architecture and infrastructure decisions.
Integrate third-party APIs and systems, and design the contracts that frontend teams and other services build against.
Perform code reviews that raise the bar, both submitting your own work and giving constructive feedback that makes your teammates better.
Surface technical blockers, risks, and client-facing issues early enough for the team to course-correct.
Advocate for best practices in testing, security, performance, and CI/CD, and encourage others to do the same.
Work directly with working-level client stakeholders over email, on calls, and in person, and start building demo and presentation content of your own.
Apply AI and agentic capabilities to real client work, and contribute back to how the craft adopts them through reusable templates, prototyping sessions, and practical guidance for other teams.
Share what you learn, internally through Slack, brown bags, and DEPT U, and externally through articles or talks as project work allows.

What You Bring

Proven experience building and maintaining production-level backend systems used by real people.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Experience designing and integrating APIs and third-party systems.
Solid working knowledge of database platforms, both SQL and NoSQL.
Enough familiarity with modern frontend development (preferably Angular and Typescript) to read the code, review a PR, and debug across the stack.
Experience with at least one major cloud provider. Google Cloud preferred, AWS or Azure also welcome.
Daily, real-world use of GenAI productivity tools (Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex) in your development workflow.
A working understanding of core LLM concepts and where they're a good fit for a problem.
Fluency with version control (git), Agile processes, and CI/CD tooling.
The ability to research independently and know when to ask for help, without spinning wheels on already-solved problems.
A track record of "getting sh*t done" in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus points

Experience mentoring engineers earlier in their careers.
Exposure to agent development frameworks.
Contributions to open source, technical writing, or conference speaking.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

We are a collaborative, open-door, best-idea-wins environment that fosters personal and company growth and has fun doing it. Here is a snapshot of our benefits package:

Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage
401k plan, plus matching
PTO
Paid Company Holidays
Parental Leave

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here .

, and organizational impact. This is based on a 40-hour workweek and leveling. Keep in mind, we’re flexible.

Senior Software Engineer Full-Time | Permanent Location New York, NY, United States Work Environment In-person

Compensation $175,000 – $200,000 per year

Schedule Monday – Friday, Eastern Time business hours

Do you use Ruby everyday? Like building something from the ground up? Equity Opportunity?

About the Opportunity We are a modern technology and services company transforming how organizations source, employ, and manage contract workers. Our goal is to provide a turnkey, full-stack software and service experience for an industry traditionally dominated by manual, cumbersome processes. We are a growing organization with an experienced engineering team and a production platform serving real customers every day. Our customers include fast-growing technology companies and innovative organizations operating in areas such as autonomous vehicles, artificial intelligence, and other emerging technologies. We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our Feature Team as we continue scaling delivery capacity across our core platform. This role is ideal for an experienced senior engineer who can quickly understand business context, collaborate closely with product partners, own features end-to-end, and help improve the overall effectiveness of the engineering team. 1 About the Role You'll work on our core staffing and workforce management application—a large, modular Rails codebase operating with real production constraints. Work often begins as loosely defined problem statements. Senior engineers are expected to bring context to those problems, shape practical solutions, clarify tradeoffs, and deliver changes that are maintainable and easy for future engineers to build upon. You'll sometimes lead initiatives and sometimes work under the direction of another senior engineer. In every situation, you'll be expected to communicate clearly, thoughtfully challenge assumptions when appropriate, and keep delivery moving forward.

What You'll Do

Own large product features end-to-end, from shaping the technical approach through delivery. Break down ambiguous business and technical problems into clear, actionable solutions. Work closely with product partners to clarify requirements and thoughtfully manage scope. Communicate proactively with teammates and leadership regarding delivery expectations and progress. Review code with a strong focus on maintainability and long-term quality—not just correctness. Write and maintain automated tests as a core responsibility. Improve legacy areas of the codebase incrementally and pragmatically. Use AI development tools, such as Copilot and Claude, to improve productivity while maintaining full accountability for the code you ship. Technology Stack

Backend: Ruby on Rails 8.1 Frontend: React 18.3, with some Stimulus and Turbo Datastores: PostgreSQL and Redis Infrastructure: Cloud-based application platform CI/CD: GitHub Actions Architecture: Modular monolith with engineers working across the full stack What Senior-Level Means in This Role A Senior Software Engineer is trusted to:
Own projects from concept through delivery. 2

Coordinate effectively with teammates contributing to the same initiative. Make thoughtful technical tradeoffs without perfect information. Improve team velocity and effectiveness—not just individual output. Senior engineers are not expected to operate on autopilot or wait for detailed instructions. They proactively identify opportunities to improve how work gets done. Compared with a mid-level engineer, senior engineers take greater ownership and initiative. Compared with staff-level engineers, the focus is more heavily on execution and team effectiveness than broader organizational or cultural leadership. Production Ownership

On-call responsibilities are very limited. A dedicated on-call engineer handles most production support and escalates issues to the Feature Team when necessary. Expected involvement in production debugging is relatively low. Expectations around testing, maintainability, and code quality are high. Requirements

Significant real-world experience with Ruby on Rails. Experience owning large product features from concept through delivery in a product-focused organization. Strong experience writing and maintaining automated tests. Comfortable partnering closely with product managers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. Demonstrated ability to work effectively with remote teammates while remaining highly communicative and proactive. Approximately 8–10 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent depth demonstrated through technical impact and accomplishments. Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading work involving Stimulus and Turbo. Experience working in entrepreneurial, startup, or early-stage environments. Strong end-to-end testing practices. Experience with ERP-style data modeling or complex business domains. Experience in staffing, HR technology, workforce management, marketplaces, or similar platforms. 3 Interview Process Candidates can expect to:

Read and discuss a small Rails application. Identify meaningful opportunities for improvement. Walk through a previous project in depth and explain—and potentially critique—technical decisions. Be evaluated on clarity, humility, collaboration, judgment, and impact, in addition to technical ability. Benefits The company offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

Equity opportunities Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents Life and disability insurance Paid parental leave Work-from-home and home office support Company-provided Apple laptop Phone and internet stipend Flexible/unlimited paid time off, along with paid office holidays 401(k) retirement plan About the Company Our mission is to make it easier for companies to build and manage high-performing contract workforces. Today, many mid-sized organizations managing contract workers must navigate significant legal, financial, talent acquisition, and operational complexities—often relying on multiple disconnected solutions for sourcing talent, employing workers, tracking workforce activity, and managing day-to-day operations. Our platform brings technology and human expertise together to provide organizations with more integrated tools and services for managing contract workforces efficiently and compliantly. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and encourage qualified candidates from all backgrounds to apply. This is a full-time, permanent position open to candidates authorized to work in the United States who are able to work during Eastern Time Zone business hours. Sponsorship and corp-to-corp arrangements are not available.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

What We Believe In

We build software for the world's most ambitious brands, and we're opinionated about how it gets made:

Code quality is a top priority. Style guides, code reviews, and best practices are how we move fast without breaking things. You'll also get your hands on a wide range of cutting-edge technology.
Great UI/UX is critical. Aesthetics, usability, and speed are all part of the product. A technically correct experience that feels bad isn't finished.
Collaboration wins projects. Great communication is the single strongest predictor of whether a project goes well.
We're pragmatic. We know what to build and what to leave alone, and we make real-world tradeoffs between cost, speed, and craft. Shipping something useful beats architecting something perfect.
We're intellectually curious. We're constantly learning through craft show & tells, lunch & learns, workshares, and active Slack channels full of talented engineers across the globe.

The role

As a Senior Engineer, you own significant portions of a project and drive them to completion. You take a semi-defined problem, ask the questions that sharpen it, turn it into a plan, and ship it. You're past the stage of needing fully specified tasks handed to you, and you're building the judgment to know which task matters most.

You're comfortable working alongside product managers, engineers, marketing, sales, and finance, and you can explain your work to any of them without retreating into jargon. Most of what we build depends on getting those people to a shared understanding of what's being made and why.

This role is primarily backend focused, occasionally diving into cloud infrastructure. However, you should also be comfortable enough in a modern frontend codebase to apply best practices and create something visually appealing and smooth to use.

What You'll Do

Build and deploy scalable backend services and APIs for global brands, taking high ownership of your workstreams and their dependencies.
Take specs that are incomplete or ambiguous, resolve the open questions, and turn them into clear requirements, tasks, and stories with time-to-complete estimates people can plan around.
Participate in technical design of systems, schemas, and pipelines, and offer sound guidance on architecture and infrastructure decisions.
Integrate third-party APIs and systems, and design the contracts that frontend teams and other services build against.
Perform code reviews that raise the bar, both submitting your own work and giving constructive feedback that makes your teammates better.
Surface technical blockers, risks, and client-facing issues early enough for the team to course-correct.
Advocate for best practices in testing, security, performance, and CI/CD, and encourage others to do the same.
Work directly with working-level client stakeholders over email, on calls, and in person, and start building demo and presentation content of your own.
Apply AI and agentic capabilities to real client work, and contribute back to how the craft adopts them through reusable templates, prototyping sessions, and practical guidance for other teams.
Share what you learn, internally through Slack, brown bags, and DEPT U, and externally through articles or talks as project work allows.

What You Bring

Proven experience building and maintaining production-level backend systems used by real people.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Experience designing and integrating APIs and third-party systems.
Solid working knowledge of database platforms, both SQL and NoSQL.
Enough familiarity with modern frontend development (preferably Angular and Typescript) to read the code, review a PR, and debug across the stack.
Experience with at least one major cloud provider. Google Cloud preferred, AWS or Azure also welcome.
Daily, real-world use of GenAI productivity tools (Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex) in your development workflow.
A working understanding of core LLM concepts and where they're a good fit for a problem.
Fluency with version control (git), Agile processes, and CI/CD tooling.
The ability to research independently and know when to ask for help, without spinning wheels on already-solved problems.
A track record of "getting sh*t done" in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus points

Experience mentoring engineers earlier in their careers.
Exposure to agent development frameworks.
Contributions to open source, technical writing, or conference speaking.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

We are a collaborative, open-door, best-idea-wins environment that fosters personal and company growth and has fun doing it. Here is a snapshot of our benefits package:

Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage
401k plan, plus matching
PTO

Parental Leave

Compensation $175,000 – $200,000 per year

Schedule Monday – Friday, Eastern Time business hours

About the Opportunity We are a modern technology and services company transforming how organizations source, employ, and manage contract workers. Our goal is to provide a turnkey, full-stack software and service experience for an industry traditionally dominated by manual, cumbersome processes. We are a growing organization with an experienced engineering team and a production platform serving real customers every day. Our customers include fast-growing technology companies and innovative organizations operating in areas such as autonomous vehicles, artificial intelligence, and other emerging technologies. We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our Feature Team as we continue scaling delivery capacity across our core platform. This role is ideal for an experienced senior engineer who can quickly understand business context, collaborate closely with product partners, own features end-to-end, and help improve the overall effectiveness of the engineering team. 1 About the Role You'll work on our core staffing and workforce management application—a large, modular Rails codebase operating with real production constraints. Work often begins as loosely defined problem statements. Senior engineers are expected to bring context to those problems, shape practical solutions, clarify tradeoffs, and deliver changes that are maintainable and easy for future engineers to build upon. You'll sometimes lead initiatives and sometimes work under the direction of another senior engineer. In every situation, you'll be expected to communicate clearly, thoughtfully challenge assumptions when appropriate, and keep delivery moving forward.

What You'll Do

Own large product features end-to-end, from shaping the technical approach through delivery. Break down ambiguous business and technical problems into clear, actionable solutions. Work closely with product partners to clarify requirements and thoughtfully manage scope. Communicate proactively with teammates and leadership regarding delivery expectations and progress. Review code with a strong focus on maintainability and long-term quality—not just correctness. Write and maintain automated tests as a core responsibility. Improve legacy areas of the codebase incrementally and pragmatically. Use AI development tools, such as Copilot and Claude, to improve productivity while maintaining full accountability for the code you ship. Technology Stack

Backend: Ruby on Rails 8.1 Frontend: React 18.3, with some Stimulus and Turbo Datastores: PostgreSQL and Redis Infrastructure: Cloud-based application platform CI/CD: GitHub Actions Architecture: Modular monolith with engineers working across the full stack What Senior-Level Means in This Role A Senior Software Engineer is trusted to:
Own projects from concept through delivery. 2

Coordinate effectively with teammates contributing to the same initiative. Make thoughtful technical tradeoffs without perfect information. Improve team velocity and effectiveness—not just individual output. Senior engineers are not expected to operate on autopilot or wait for detailed instructions. They proactively identify opportunities to improve how work gets done. Compared with a mid-level engineer, senior engineers take greater ownership and initiative. Compared with staff-level engineers, the focus is more heavily on execution and team effectiveness than broader organizational or cultural leadership. Production Ownership

On-call responsibilities are very limited. A dedicated on-call engineer handles most production support and escalates issues to the Feature Team when necessary. Expected involvement in production debugging is relatively low. Expectations around testing, maintainability, and code quality are high. Requirements

Significant real-world experience with Ruby on Rails. Experience owning large product features from concept through delivery in a product-focused organization. Job Description:

The National Space Test and Training Complex–Orbital (NSTTC-O) Range Control Software (RCS) program operates a mission-critical platform stack across on-premises OpenStack and Amazon Web Services (AWS) GovCloud within a rigorous Joint Special Access Program Implementation Guide (JSIG) and Risk Management Framework (RMF) compliance envelope, and is seeking a senior technical leader to guide and strengthen that infrastructure layer. As the program prepares for the Region 2 data center migration, the Development, Integration, and Test (DevI&T) Integrated Product Team (IPT) seeks an experienced Integrated Product Team Lead (IPTL) to lead platform engineering, coordinate subcontractor delivery, and provide the clear technical direction needed to keep delivery pipelines producing compliant increments and the Authorization to Operate (ATO) defensible without sacrificing strategic oversight.

Essential Functions:

Lead platform engineering for the Amazon Web Services GovCloud and OpenStack environment.
Direct the infrastructure work supporting the Region 2 data center migration.
Build and sustain infrastructure automation and deployment workflows.
Establish and maintain delivery pipelines using Bitbucket, Jenkins, GitLab, and related tools.
Develop and maintain infrastructure and configuration automation using Terraform, Ansible, shell scripting, and Python.
Integrate security and compliance considerations into platform operations and delivery.
Coordinate platform-engineering execution and subcontractor delivery.
Travel up to 15% as needed to support program and customer requirements.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.
Current CompTIA Security+ certification.
Active TS/SCI security clearance.

Preferred Additional Skills:

Experience designing, deploying, and sustaining Amazon Web Services GovCloud and OpenStack infrastructure.
Experience administering and troubleshooting Linux-based systems in production environments.
Experience deploying, operating, and securing Kubernetes environments.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration automation using Terraform and Ansible.
Experience with shell scripting and Python.
Amazon Web Services certification, such as Amazon Web Services Certified Solutions Architect or a role-aligned specialty certification.
Certified OpenStack Administrator certification or comparable OpenStack certification.
Red Hat Certified System Administrator or Red Hat Certified Engineer certification.
Experience building and maintaining delivery pipelines in Bitbucket, Jenkins, and GitLab.
Experience implementing automated security and compliance checks within delivery pipelines.
Experience supporting on-premises-to-cloud or data-center migration efforts in regulated environments.
Experience with Helm, Argo CD, Packer, or comparable deployment and configuration automation tools.
Experience developing automation or operational tooling using Lua.
